findings.claim: The new 'Which path serves a Gemini call' line says Totem's Gemini orchestrator is SDK-first and that 'a model id is therefore judged against the API's routing table first'. That is false for totem init's highest-priority Gemini branch, which this same commit re-stamps.
findings.counterexample: packages/cli/src/commands/init-detect.ts:323-329: '// 1. Gemini CLI on PATH → shell provider' emits { provider: 'shell', command: 'gemini --model {model} -o json -e none < {file}', overrides: buildRoleOverrides(INIT_ORCHESTRATOR_MODELS.geminiCli) }. orchestrator.ts:744-751 runs provider 'shell' straight through invokeShellOrchestrator with route 'configured-shell'. There is no SDK attempt and no withCliFallback. For any consumer with the gemini binary on PATH (detection priority 1, before GEMINI_API_KEY at :342), the stamped id is judged by the CLI's registry, not the API's routing table. The sentence holds only for provider: 'gemini' (orchestrator.ts:752-756 wraps the SDK invoker in withCliFallback; isFallbackEligible at :625-635 matches only 'is not installed', 'no gemini api key', 'cannot find module' and the like).

findings.claim: The changeset, the init-detect.ts doc comment (lines 246-249) and the docs (line 21 'the Gemini CLI rewrites it to gemini-3.8-flash'; line 36 'the CLI's own registry still maps gemini-3.5-flash to gemini-3.8-flash') all state the CLI rewrite as unconditional. The cited registry gates it on a flag.
findings.counterexample: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/main/packages/core/src/config/models.ts lines 137-142: 'When LATEST_FLASH_GA_LAUNCHED is true: rewrites BASE_GEMINI_FLASH_MODEL (gemini-3.5-flash) ... -> LATEST_GEMINI_FLASH_MODEL (gemini-3.8-flash). When LATEST_FLASH_GA_LAUNCHED is false on Code Assist (CCPA): maps gemini-3.5-flash -> gemini-3-flash.' The code (~149-157) reads 'const useLatestFlash = context?.hasLatestFlashGAAccess?.() ?? false; if (useLatestFlash) {...} else if (isCodeAssistBackend) { mappings[BASE_GEMINI_FLASH_MODEL] = LEGACY_CCPA_FLASH_MODEL; }'. So the default is no rewrite to 3.8. On a non-Code-Assist backend the id passes through unmapped (and then hits the API's route to 3.6). mmnto-ai/totem-strategy#1554's own fold F3 recorded this; this commit dropped the qualifier. The changeset ships into the published CHANGELOG. The re-pin's conclusion still stands, because the old id is not served as written on any branch.

findings.claim: The docs conclude that Google's June 18 retirement 'did not hold as written for that path' from one probe. Neither the probe's account tier nor the probe's auth mode is established in its source, and the bullet does not cite that source.
findings.counterexample: The release-notes banner Note (page top, not a dated entry) says: 'Starting June 18, 2026, Gemini Code Assist IDE Extensions and Gemini CLI stopped serving requests for the Gemini Code Assist for individuals, Google AI Pro, and Google AI Ultra tiers.' mmnto-ai/totem-strategy#1554 records the measurement in its BODY ('a CLI probe gemini -m gemini-3.8-flash -p ... → OK (0.64.0, 2026-10-15)'; 'the 0.64.0 CLI running under a personal OAuth login on this seat'). It has 0 comments. The same body says 'On the strategy seat the key is set' (GEMINI_API_KEY). Questions for the seat: (a) was the probe's CLI auth actually oauth-personal and not the API key in env? (b) is the account on one of the three named tiers? Without both, 'did not hold as written' outruns the measurement. The bullet does frame it as a measurement, not as Google's statement (that part held), but it carries no mmnto-ai/totem-strategy#1554 cite.

findings.claim: The Argon row says 'the public pages read state no pricing or tier'. Google's public pricing page states both, and the models page calls Argon the flagship while this table's 'Flagship' label sits on gemini-3.8-flash.
findings.counterexample: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (Last updated 2026-10-15): 'Note: Gemini 4 Argon is not available on the Free tier or on the Google AI Pro plan.'; Standard paid input '$2.00 through November 30, 2026. $4.00 starting December 1, 2026.', output '$10.00 ... $20.00'. https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models: 'Gemini 4 Argon — Our flagship reasoning model ... New Stable', and 'Gemini 3.8 Flash — Our most intelligent Flash model ... New Stable' (both are 'New Stable'). The models page states no date for Argon, and the argon model page says only 'Latest update October 2026'.

findings.claim: 'gemini-3.1-flash-lite is the previous lite' omits that the deprecations page lists an announced shutdown for it.
findings.counterexample: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations, Gemini 3 table: '| gemini-3.1-flash-lite | May 7, 2026 | May 7, 2027 | gemini-3.5-flash-lite'.

findings.claim: 'access limited to projects that have used it' paraphrases the page, which says users. Line 28's 'prior users' matches the page.
findings.counterexample: deprecations page, both 2.5 notes: 'we are limiting access to the 2.5 models to users who have actively used them in the past.'

findings.claim: The changeset (and docs line 35) names only GEMINI_API_KEY. The detection branch and the SDK invoker both also accept GOOGLE_API_KEY.
findings.counterexample: packages/cli/src/commands/init-detect.ts:342 'hasKey(envContent, GEMINI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY)'; packages/cli/src/orchestrators/gemini-orchestrator.ts:58 'process.env[GEMINI_API_KEY] ?? process.env[GOOGLE_API_KEY]'; init-detect.test.ts:92 covers the GOOGLE_API_KEY row.

findings.claim: The commit message names two intentional leftovers, but there is a third unnamed one in the very test file the commit touched. It is harmless.
findings.counterexample: init-detect.test.ts:200 'lanes: [anthropic:claude-sonnet-5, gemini:gemini-3.5-flash]' and :204 expect the same rendered text. This is a sample input to the array-rendering test, not a default, so leaving it is sound, but it is unnamed. The other leftovers (.totem/fixtures/spec-runs-2026-09-02/**, .totem/specs/2700.md, 2792.md, 2799-transport-shield.md) are historical run records and correctly untouched.

verdict: read 1 on 58abf157 (the whole commit, parent d3dd8437): as typed, 0 BLOCKING, 2 MATERIAL, 5 MINOR, 1 QUESTION. Held at source: the deprecations page's 3.8-flash, 3.5-flash and 3.7-flash rows, the 2.5 rows' not-deprecated status and the new-project pointer; the Code Assist entry of October 09, 2026; models.ts's two constants; the init-detect tests exercise the new id through detection against an independent literal table; no stale default stamp elsewhere; the two named leftovers sound. Folded by the seat: F1 (the docs bullet now names both paths — the shell-provider config init emits first when the gemini binary is on PATH is judged by the CLI's registry, the SDK provider by the API's routing — and the id has to be current on both), F2 (the CLI rewrite stated as flag-gated in the docs, the code comment and the changeset), F4 (the Argon row carries the pricing page's tier note and prices, and Google's flagship label), F5 (the 3.1-flash-lite shutdown of May 7, 2027 stated), F6 (the page's word, users), F7 (GOOGLE_API_KEY named beside GEMINI_API_KEY in the docs and the changeset). Answered: F3 (the docs bullet no longer concludes the retirement did not hold; it reports the probe with its limit — the record names a personal OAuth login but the seat also carries the key and the two were not separated — and cites mmnto-ai/totem-strategy#1554; the auth-mode question goes to the strategy seat by mail), F8 (the test's sample lanes input named as a third intentional leftover in the fold commit message).
